format.notes: Dry voice only. No reverb, music or effects; peaks under -3 dBFS; trim silence to ~50 ms. Effects are added in the mix.

archivist.role: M.E.G. archivist narrating the recovered tape (same narrator in every episode)
archivist.voice: Adult, neutral-to-low voice, any gender. Flat, clinical, measured. Must be the SAME voice as the archivist in Ep01/Ep02.

swimmer.role: A lone wanderer, a woman in her late 20s, who dived into the water of Level 58 and surfaced here. She filmed with a waterproof camera.
swimmer.voice: Woman, late 20s, soft and breathy, speaking quietly to herself. Calm, awed, increasingly peaceful — never frightened enough to shout.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 录像编号 037-S。她从 Level 58 的水里潜了下去。再浮上来时，已经在这里了。
lines.en: Tape 037-S. She dived into the water of Level 58. When she came up, she was here.
lines.tts_text: 录像编号，零三七，S。她从五十八层的水里潜了下去。再浮上来时，已经在这里了。

lines.speaker: swimmer
lines.subtitle: 「（喘气）……天哪。」
lines.direction: Just surfaced, catching her breath, stunned and amazed. Breathy.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: Level 37，「崇高」。人们更习惯叫它「泳池房」。
lines.en: Level 37, “Sublimity”. Most people call it the Poolrooms.
lines.tts_text: 三十七层，「崇高」。人们更习惯叫它，「泳池房」。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 几乎所有表面都铺着白色瓷砖。崭新，完美，无法破坏。
lines.en: Almost every surface is white ceramic tile. Pristine. Flawless. Indestructible.
lines.tts_text: 几乎所有表面，都铺着白色瓷砖。崭新，完美，无法破坏。
lines.direction: Measured; a short beat between the three adjectives.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 水是温的，含有泻盐。它会让你的肌肉放松，让疼痛消失。
lines.en: The water is warm, and full of Epsom salt. It relaxes the muscles. It makes the pain go away.
lines.tts_text: 水是温的，含有泻盐。它会让你的肌肉放松，让疼痛消失。
lines.direction: Flat, but a little softer on 让疼痛消失.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 这里没有实体，没有基地，没有人。没有人知道为什么。
lines.en: No entities. No bases. No people. No one knows why.
lines.tts_text: 这里没有实体，没有基地，没有人。没有人知道为什么。

lines.speaker: swimmer
lines.subtitle: 「喂——」
lines.direction: Calling out across the hall, medium volume. (The mix will cut it off mid-word on purpose.)

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 声音在这里会突然消失。回声不对劲。说话听起来，像隔着一层什么东西。
lines.en: Sound drops off without warning. The echoes are wrong. Speech sounds like it’s coming through something.
lines.tts_text: 声音在这里会突然消失。回声不对劲。说话听起来，像隔着一层什么东西。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 有些楼梯会一直向下，通进深不见底的水里。
lines.en: Some staircases keep going down, into water with no bottom.
lines.tts_text: 有些楼梯会一直向下，通进深不见底的水里。

lines.speaker: swimmer
lines.subtitle: 「……下面有什么？」
lines.direction: Uneasy whisper, curious more than scared.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 光线从奇怪的角度照进来。有些地方，一点光都没有。
lines.en: Light falls in at strange angles. Some places get none at all.
lines.tts_text: 光线从奇怪的角度照进来。有些地方，一点光都没有。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 那种黑暗不像危险。更像一个你早就做过的噩梦——熟悉得让人安心不下来。
lines.en: The dark doesn’t feel dangerous. It feels like a nightmare you’ve had before — too familiar to be comforting.
lines.tts_text: 那种黑暗不像危险。更像一个你早就做过的噩梦，熟悉得让人安心不下来。

lines.speaker: swimmer
lines.subtitle: 「我想……在这里待一会儿。」
lines.en: “I think I’ll… stay here a while.”
lines.direction: Floating on her back, deeply relaxed, smiling, sleepy.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 就算没有任何东西碰过，水也一直在轻轻地动。像潮汐。
lines.en: Even when nothing touches it, the water keeps moving. Like a tide.
lines.tts_text: 就算没有任何东西碰过，水也一直在轻轻地动。像潮汐。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 如果你让自己沉下去——你可能会从另一个地方浮上来。
lines.en: If you let yourself sink — you may come up somewhere else.
lines.tts_text: 如果你让自己沉下去，你可能会从另一个地方，浮上来。
lines.direction: Slow, a beat before 浮上来.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 她日志里的最后一句是：「难以形容地奇怪，又难以形容地完美。」
lines.en: The last line in her journal: “Indescribably strange, yet indescribably perfect.”
lines.tts_text: 她日志里的最后一句是，难以形容地奇怪，又难以形容地完美。
